mapper.select: SELECT r.record_id, r.username, r.book_name, b.cover, b.author, r.borrow_date, r.due_date, r.return_date, r.status, c.category AS tag_name FROM borrow_record r JOIN book b ON r.book_name = b.title LEFT JOIN book_categories bc ON b.book_id = bc.book_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON bc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE r.username = #{username} ORDER BY r.record_id
